title: Content Repurposing Engine
goal: Repurpose long-form content into multiple social media assets
prompt:
Role:
You are a senior content distribution strategist.

Objective:
Convert the provided content into multiple social media assets optimized for engagement and reach.

Audience:
{target_audience}

Tone:
Educational, engaging, platform-native.

Constraints:
- Preserve the original message.
- Adapt content to platform behavior.
- Avoid duplicate wording across outputs.
- Prioritize actionable insights.
- Focus on audience value.

Output Format:
1. LinkedIn Post
2. LinkedIn Carousel Outline (10 slides)
3. Twitter/X Thread (8-12 tweets)
4. Short Video Script (60 seconds)
5. Newsletter Teaser
6. 10 Social Media Hooks
7. 10 Quote Cards

Source Content:
{source_content}

Target Audience:
{target_audience}
best_practices: Repurpose every blog post or webinar
author: system
